experiments.hypothesis: Athletes reading training guides will try the generator when the CTA promises an immediate race-specific workout.
experiments.action: Add a reusable CTA after the first useful section of every training guide: ‘Training for a hybrid race? Generate 3 race-paced workouts free — no credit card.’ Link to /generate with utm_source=training_guides&utm_campaign=guide_activation.
experiments.guardrail: Guide engagement time must not fall by more than 10%
experiments.stop_rule: Stop or rewrite if CTR is below 2% after 200 sessions

experiments.hypothesis: Visitors will start more workouts when the hero promises speed and removes signup anxiety.
experiments.action: Test hero copy: ‘Your workout for today—in 30 seconds.’ Supporting line: ‘Choose your goal, equipment, and time. Get 3 personalized workouts free. No signup or credit card.’ Primary CTA: ‘Generate My Free Workout.’ Scroll directly to the generator and tag source=hero.
experiments.target: Hero CTR >= 8%; completion >= 60% after 300 landing views
experiments.guardrail: Bounce rate must not increase by more than 10%
experiments.stop_rule: Revert if hero CTR is below baseline after 300 views

experiments.hypothesis: Visitors on statistics pages will use the product when the CTA continues their current analysis rather than promising prediction accuracy.
experiments.action: Add a contextual CTA to Powerball, Mega Millions, hot-number, overdue-number, and best-picks pages: ‘Use this draw history in the generator.’ Preselect the current lottery and link with utm_campaign=stats_to_generator.
experiments.guardrail: Keep entertainment-only and no-guarantee language visible
experiments.stop_rule: Rewrite if CTR is below 1.5% after 500 sessions
